title: vektor /// no. 046 — Four things to do with Claude Fable 5.1.
description: Anthropic shipped Fable 5.1 on 1 September 2026. Four moves worth making this week, with the prompt for each one written out: point it at something you already built and ask it to be three hostile readers; build one small agent that runs read-do-check without you; describe the hardest problem you have not solved, failures included; and re-sort your jobs by effort level now that cache reads have fallen 75% to $0.25 per million tokens.
